item.text: {"summary":"The draft is publishable in structure but should tighten the resolver-date discrepancy and interval arithmetic before publication.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"warning","summary":"The cell matches the registered resolutionDate of 2026-10-15, but the resolutionRule embeds a conflicting claim that the BLS calendar says the September 2026 Employment Situation release is October 2, 2026.","actionRequested":"Keep resolutionDate tied to the ledger contract, but either remove the calendar-discrepancy sentence from the resolutionRule or move it to reasoning only with the exact cited evidence preserved; do not let the resolver text imply an alternate resolution date."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The interval says sigma = 0.248 and 1.28*sigma = 0.317, but the published 80% bounds are roughly +/-0.35 around the point estimate.","actionRequested":"State the explicit widening rule from 0.317 to about 0.35 million, or adjust the interval to match the stated volatility method."}],"optionalSuggestions":["The prior/update/interval step is otherwise compact and useful; keeping the arithmetic visibly tied to 16.154 + 0.068 = 16.222 would make the rounded 16.22 point clearer.","The tail scenarios are adequate, but naming approximate low/high values for repeat CPS-sample drops or rebounds would make them more concrete."]}
